description.en: Mylodon darwinii has a long narrow head, low shaggy body and strong curved foreclaws. Whole-body proportions, fur distribution and colour are estimates; claw shape alone does not establish digging or burrowing behaviour.
description.zh: 达尔文磨齿兽 Mylodon darwinii 具有狭长头部、低矮蓬毛身体和强壮弯曲的前爪。全身比例、毛长分布及颜色为估计；爪形本身不能证明挖掘或掘洞行为。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original Mylodon darwinii living reconstruction informed by NHM holotype jaw and preserved skin photographs, Reinhardt1879 skull plate, and explicitly labelled NHM-published life reconstruction. Not a scan or a complete articulated fossil replica.

scientific_limits.en: Whole-body proportions, low walking stance, fur length distribution, original color, claw curvature and soft muzzle are estimates. Preserved jaw and skin directly support only those tissues; published life reconstruction is interpretation. Original digging-claw wording is retained as a shape label, not proof of digging or burrowing behavior. Do not use old Mylodon robustus illustrations as M.darwinii anatomy.
scientific_limits.zh: 全身比例、低位行走姿态、各处毛长分布、原始颜色、爪弯曲度及软吻部均为估值。保存的颌骨与皮肤只直接支持相应组织；已发表的活体复原属于解释。保留原清单掘爪措辞作为形状标签，不把它当作挖掘或掘洞行为的证据。不得把旧名 Mylodon robustus 的图当作 M.darwinii 解剖依据。

frozen_scientific_scope.taxon_scope: Mylodon darwinii; historical Grypotherium darwini/Glossotherium darwini references distinguished from modern Glossotherium robustum

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Length broadly follows NHM approximate3m; width/height and posture are artistic estimates, not a measured complete specimen.

shape_requirements: Original long narrow head, low shaggy body and robust digging-shaped claws retained together. Claw geometry does not assert burrowing behavior.
Elongated tapering muzzle on a relatively small head, deep low trunk and strong limbs; not broad short Glossotherium muzzle or upright giant Megatherium silhouette.
Visible stout curved foreclaws separated from supporting paw surfaces; preserve leg gaps beneath shaggy belly.
Low coarse fur silhouette in restrained faceted masses; no dense hair particles or bear-like round face. Strong tapering tail remains subordinate.
construction_notes: Choose calm low quadrupedal stance to meet original body gate; do not copy the museum illustration's rearing pose.
Fossil skin has embedded ossicles, not an exposed armored shell. Represent shaggy outer coat, not naked pebble armor.
Warm gray/brown neutral color is an art choice, not reconstructed exact living pigment from preserved fur.
Published skull plate supports elongate bony muzzle only. Skin covers nasal bony structures; do not turn them into a decorative facial horn.

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: long narrow head and low shaggy body with robust digging claws. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：长窄头、低毛躯干与粗壮掘爪。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block long narrow head and low shaggy body with robust digging claws with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织长窄头、低毛躯干与粗壮掘爪；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
